assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are provisional rough substitutes derived by project maintainers from public text and approximate area constraints.
assumptions.impact: All boundary-dependent geometry and metrics must be replaced and recalculated before statutory or precision use.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities and engineering constraints are not present in the public package.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, demolition, parking and infrastructure capacity remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: OSM road, rail and water features provide public orientation context only and may be incomplete or generalized.
assumptions.impact: They cannot establish official boundaries, redlines, protection zones or engineering conditions.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios, landmarks, operating bodies and phasing are design recommendations rather than commitments by public agencies or named organizations.
assumptions.impact: Each scenario requires privacy, safety, accessibility, copyright, community and professional review before deployment.

assumptions.statement: Land-use cells, building footprints, public-space nodes and scenario zones are design representations generated within a provisional corridor, not a survey of all existing parcels or buildings.
assumptions.impact: Counts and coverage ratios measure proposal representation only; they must not be read as existing-condition density or approved construction scale.

assumptions.statement: LAND_USE code 1403 records broad functional envelopes, while PUBLIC_SPACE records only the nine directly designed intervention footprints.
assumptions.impact: Their areas are intentionally not equal and should be reconciled after official parcel and public-realm data are supplied.

assumptions.statement: JZ-AIOS stage gates, scenario passports, public-value gates and sunset reviews are proposed governance protocols, not enacted rules.
assumptions.impact: Responsible authorities, communities and professional reviewers must define thresholds, legal bases and accountable operators before any live test.

assumptions.statement: References to Beijing innovation districts, science cities and regional relay testing describe optional collaboration roles only.
assumptions.impact: No external organization, district or city is represented as committed to participate.

assumptions.statement: Historic narratives, landmark names, AI-generated media and honor displays require source verification, rights clearance, generated-content labeling and an accessible correction channel.
assumptions.impact: Unverified or disputed content must remain unpublished or be withdrawn pending curatorial review.

assumptions.statement: Public sources report that Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park Phase II opened on 2026-08-06, but this submission has not completed a dated post-opening field audit, operator interview or as-built review.
assumptions.impact: The open park is treated as a reported baseline, while continuity, accessibility, facility condition, use patterns and suitable pilot locations remain subject to field verification.

assumptions.statement: The six gateways, scenario nodes, AI service zones and named existing-space opportunities are concept references within provisional geometry; no exact pilot footprint, owner consent or delivery authority is confirmed.
assumptions.impact: All physical and digital pilots remain at G0 and must pass site, ownership, community, professional, approval and restoration checks before location-specific design or deployment.

assumptions.statement: The T-02 G0 contract has completed one deterministic replay of ten fixed, PII-free synthetic cases with ten exact expected-decision matches, all four distinct declared stop events mapped to their exact recovery actions, and ten exact fail-closed controls covering fixture and contract drift, source closure, precedence, and canonical RACI closure. This proves contract logic only; it does not demonstrate a substantive answer, answer correctness, live source freshness, successful real human handoff, model or API interaction, service operation, field evidence, approval, accountable-owner confirmation, independent real retest, G1 completion, or operating non-AI parity.
assumptions.impact: The scene remains at G0. Any G1 application still depends on accountable source and service owners, refreshed sources, an actually available human and non-AI path, approved site/sample/window/effect threshold/version lock, professional review, approvals, and an independent real retester.

assumptions.statement: The key-area evidence matrix joins each provisional key-area feature to conceptual state-station, public-anchor, interface, AI-zone, scenario and acceptance references; these joins are design relationships rather than surveyed spatial or institutional relationships.
assumptions.impact: The matrix improves review traceability but cannot establish an official boundary, exact site, owner consent, approval, field observation, partner commitment or operating result. Replace and re-run the crosswalk when organizer geometry, owner evidence and field records are available.
